title: Customer security requirements routing and escalation lifecycle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a deterministic routing and escalation lifecycle for incoming customer security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires). Goal: reduce time-to-acknowledge, fast-fail impossible asks, auto-assemble evidence packets, and ensure consistent SLAs across self-serve, sales-assisted, and enterprise channels.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic score for each incoming request (0-100) that combines risk, complexity, and customer tier
Automated routing rules: self-serve docs, Solutions Engineering triage, Security & Legal escalation
Fast-fail gating for unsupported asks (e.g., impossible data residency demands) with templated customer responses
Evidence packet auto-assembly: Confluence/GDrive links + prefilled answers for common questionnaire sections
Metrics dashboard with time-to-ack, time-to-resolution, escalation rate, and SLA attainment by tier
work_items: Define scoring rubric (risk, technical feasibility, regulatory complexity, customer tier)
Prototype parser for vendor questionnaires (CSV/PDF/Word) to extract sections and map to canonical evidence
Policy matrix for HIPAA/GDPR/HSM/KMS requirements that maps to supported product capabilities
Create templated fast-fail responses and evidence packet templates per questionnaire type
Implement routing rules in intake service and add webhook to Solutions Engineering queue
Build a small Console dashboard for intake SLAs and open queue heatmap
notes: We will prioritize automations that save Solutions Engineering time: auto-fill, evidence bundling, and fast-fail logic.
Scope should include both async questionnaire uploads and in-sales Slack/Sheets intake flows.
Consider lightweight NLP model for mapping arbitrary question text to canonical control IDs (SOC2/ISO/GDPR).
Legal prefers handoff to Security & Legal for any request with score >=70 or requests referencing contractual changes.
